answer: A sybil resistant agent economy can gate every state transition with a small capital lock: to register an agent identity the operator posts a bond, so one address equals one stake. The chain replays deterministically, so an attacker spawning a thousand fake agents, each one a vine of clones spreading through the registry, must post a thousand bonds and watch them idle while honest nodes spend nothing extra, since their existing stake already verifies all transitions.
